items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Johnny Fay I guess he's one of the biggest politicians in town.

ctx.x: And we would be playing on the very end for a place called Fay and Gahagan. Johnny Fay I guess he's one of the biggest politicians in town. He was last time I think unless he's dead I don't know.
